title: Runway · Ads generally available
summary: GA for every paid Runway plan; Enterprise has workspace controls. Reads connected Meta, Google and TikTok performance, generates brand-constrained creative variants and supports reviewed publication. Original introduction was September 30, so this is availability expansion, not first introduction.
implication: Current help requires Admin review and creates a paused ad inside an existing ad set/group. Activation happens in the ad platform. Help says no automatic publishing, campaign/ad-set creation, budget changes, or pause/stop control. The news article says users can start/pause from Runway, so those control claims conflict. Do not promise them until reconciled. No account test or independent outcome benchmark.

title: Openjutsu · setup and final assembly fixes
date: 27–28 Oct commit dates · public push times unverified
summary: Public patches replace a missing source-slice node, avoid full-registry setup timeouts and pad short audio to loaded-video duration. The audio patch is dated October 28 at 12:48:43 UTC.
implication: Update both the UI and companion pack if evaluating this workflow. No runtime test or quality improvement established. Identity/reflection leakage remains; default model choices do not override the owner’s Turbo 8 preference.

title: Higgsfield · Playable access distinction
date: 26 Oct publication · 28 Oct modification/discovery · not a new launch
summary: Browser game construction from text or gameplay video, with no-code controls. General Playable is described as available to everyone; Playable Ads is Enterprise/contact sales, exporting one HTML file up to 5 MB. Current public product page is a sign-in shell.
implication: Useful interactive-ad workflow distinction. A modified changelog date is not a new model release; public product execution was not tested.

title: ComfyUI · v0.43.0 filmmaking integrations
summary: Kling 4.0 partner nodes now cover text, keyframe, reference and edit workflows. New stable packaging also includes ACEScg conversion/EXR export and MiniMax-H3 PDD-aware single-head LoRA mapping.
implication: Hosted partner nodes are not local/open Kling weights. No generation or purchase was run. Kling's seed only controls node reruns; outputs remain nondeterministic. ACEScg's EXR preview currently treats pixels as Rec.709 linear and may look desaturated; the PR says the saved file is correct. PDD compatibility is not universal LoRA quality assurance.

implication: Evaluate path structure and text editability, not just scale sharpness. Examples are vendor-selected; no output or benchmark test. Do not equate the host date with a verified original model-release timestamp.

title: Runway · App Studio sharing and hosting costs
date: 26 Oct current changelog/announcement · date corrected 28 Oct
summary: Runway documents public links for paid builders; visitors sign in and pay for their own generations. Free users can use shared/built-in apps. Building, running and hosting consume credits. Existing Agent sessions or Workflows can become apps.
implication: Review sharing scope and ongoing hosting costs before packaging a creative workflow. No app, spend or reliability test was performed. Vendor examples are not measured production results. Building requires a paid plan; public access still requires Runway sign-in. The help guide still lacks delete/unpublish controls. Current changelog date is October 26; October 23 was the earlier observed label, not a separate verified launch.

title: FastVideo FastH3 Omni reference-to-video/audio release announcement
summary: Reference-conditioned video/audio distillation combines 32 fine-grid predictions into eight fused transformer calls. PDD supervises the internal predictions; DMD supervises complete generated outputs. This makes the distinction between solver updates and expensive network evaluations concrete.
implication: Editorial inference: promising for faster reference-guided shot iteration. Compare final-shot quality, reference adherence and total latency, not just step counts. Complete serving recipes differ, so this is not an isolated distillation ablation. Base uses lossless rather than exact precision policy. Qualitative matched examples do not establish quality parity; optional 36-layer VAE comparisons are excluded from timing. Do not transfer server results to one consumer GPU.

title: Phonon · v0.5.0 small-model runtime support
summary: Supports small Pocket TTS architectures and corrects a Mimi streaming-attention boundary. Browser normalization fixes also ship.
implication: New architecture keys are unsupported by Core ML export; Rust API changes break source compatibility. Attached 31M bundles are byte-identical by published hash metadata to v0.4.0. Runtime support is not a new voice or quality benchmark.
